title: Xanthe and the Harvest
author: Felix Crane
blurb: Yara Thornbury, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
